in_sanskrit.name: Diara
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of River
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Diara एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Diara is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Dhari’ which means ‘to hold’ and ‘Ara’ meaning ‘river’. This name is associated with the goddess Ganga, who is revered for her nurturing and purifying qualities. Diara represents the divine force that sustains life by providing water, and is a symbol of strength, resilience, and renewal.
